simulatorVersion: Not exposed by the web UI
observations: The web service compiled the supplied sketch and started an emulated UNO; the startup marker was visible.
Eight alternating D8 digitalRead results were visible in the serial monitor before pausing at 3.9 seconds of simulated time.
The displayed virtual circuit contained the UNO, 330-ohm resistor and red LED with the supplied connections.
limits: This pass covers startup and observed digital output toggling only, not every possible firmware fault.
The compiled binary digest and hosted build/toolchain versions were not exposed or exported.
Timing tolerance, analog/power/current behavior and physical wiring were not independently measured.
The guest project was not saved to a hosted account; the sketch and diagram are preserved beside this record for reproduction.
